==70%==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="4" |I want to place a bet on the Derby so I look at some online tipsters. Mr Tips is incorrect 70% of the time, the Tipmaster 60%, Tips-R-Us only 40% and Born Tippy just 20%. Whose advise should I take?
|-
|Mr Tips
|Tipmaster
|Tips-R-Us
|'''Born Tippy'''
|}
Born Tippy is only INCORRECT 20% of the time, so is therefore correct the most.

==60%==
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="3" |Which of the following words won’t spell another word when you change the middle letter to every other vowel?
|-
|Bag
|Pat
|'''Hay'''
|}
Bag changes to Beg, Big, Bog and Bug. Pat becomes Pet, Pit, Pot and Put but Hay has Hiy and Huy which are not words.

==45%==
Which word continues the pattern to complete the sentence?
{| class="fandom-table"
! colspan="3" |Si'''ll'''y du'''mm'''ies ru'''nn'''ing l'''oo'''se…
|-
|Wildly
|'''Happily'''
|Frequently
|}
Each word uses consecutive double letters: LL, MM, NN, OO so the next words needs a PP.

==35%==
If Butch is from the Netherlands and Herman is from Germany, which country is Trish from?

If you change the first letter of Butch and Herman you get their nationality: Dutch and German. If you change the ‘T’ in Trish to an ‘I’, she becomes Irish.

{| class="fandom-table"

|-
|'''ALF'''
|SUE
|MEG
|BEN
|}
If you include the handle as a C, the top row all spell new words – CHAT, CLOG, COLD and CROW. Of the bottom row of mugs, only ALF makes a new word when you include the C – CALF.
